query: select clock_timestamp() as checked_at,jsonb_object_agg(name,jsonb_build_object('count',n,'digest',digest)) as projection from(select 'works' as name,count(*) as n,md5(string_agg(row::text,'' order by row::text collate "C")) as digest from(select jsonb_build_object('author',a.name,'author_id',t."author_id",'cover_id',t."cover_id",'first_publish_year',t."first_publish_year",'id',t."id",'native_identity_key',t."native_identity_key",'open_library_id',t."open_library_id",'source_type',t."source_type",'subtitle',t."subtitle",'title',t."title",'work_type',t."work_type") as row from public.works t join public.authors a on a.id=t.author_id)p union all select 'editions' as name,count(*) as n,md5(string_agg(row::text,'' order by row::text collate "C")) as digest from(select jsonb_build_object('created_at',t."created_at",'id',t."id",'isbn_10',t."isbn_10",'isbn_13',t."isbn_13",'language',t."language",'open_library_edition_id',t."open_library_edition_id",'publisher',t."publisher",'title',t."title",'work_id',t."work_id") as row from public.editions t)p union all select 'authors' as name,count(*) as n,md5(string_agg(row::text,'' order by row::text collate "C")) as digest from(select jsonb_build_object('id',t."id",'name',t."name",'open_library_id',t."open_library_id") as row from public.authors t)p union all select 'metadata' as name,count(*) as n,md5(string_agg(row::text,'' order by row::text collate "C")) as digest from(select jsonb_build_object('bound_author_id',t."bound_author_id",'bound_isbn13',t."bound_isbn13",'bound_language',t."bound_language",'bound_title',t."bound_title",'card_cover_url',t."card_cover_url",'cover_url',t."cover_url",'edition_id',t."edition_id",'evidence',t."evidence",'evidence_url',t."evidence_url",'format',t."format",'review_batch',t."review_batch",'review_status',t."review_status",'reviewed_at',t."reviewed_at",'work_id',t."work_id") as row from public.catalog_edition_metadata t)p union all select 'descriptions' as name,count(*) as n,md5(string_agg(row::text,'' order by row::text collate "C")) as digest from(select jsonb_build_object('bound_author_id',t."bound_author_id",'evidence',t."evidence",'language',t."language",'provenance',t."provenance",'review_batch',t."review_batch",'review_status',t."review_status",'reviewed_at',t."reviewed_at",'source_name',t."source_name",'source_type',t."source_type",'source_url',t."source_url",'text',t."text",'work_id',t."work_id") as row from public.catalog_work_descriptions t)p union all select 'aliases' as name,count(*) as n,md5(string_agg(row::text,'' order by row::text collate "C")) as digest from(select jsonb_build_object('title',t."title",'work_id',t."work_id") as row from public.catalog_work_title_aliases t)p)q;
serialization: Explicit C collation avoids differing locale sort of prose. Earlier default-collation aggregate mismatch was disproved by all695matching per-row hashes; no changed production descriptions.
